name: dubai-developed-in-fortnite-2033-november-11
lines:
بنتها وايلد أنليميتد (Wild Unlimited)
بمحرر UEFN

تضم عشرة معالم من دبي، منها
حصن الفهيدي وبرج الماس

يوم الإطلاق تُقام فعالية عامة
في سولت (SALT) على كايت بيتش

لم يُعلن بعد رمز الجزيرة أو سعرها
أو منصاتها

مشروع مستقل لا ترعاه ولا تديره
إيبك غيمز (Epic Games)
headline:
جزيرة دبي داخل Fortnite
تُطلق عالميًا في 11 نوفمبر
label: رسمي

tried: DMCC article page (one image, the hero key art, no video)
Whats On Dubai (same image credited to DMCC)
Wild Unlimited site (no trailer found in search)
Epic: no trailer, island is independent

angle.hook: Ten Dubai landmarks become a Fortnite island that goes live worldwide on 11 November
angle.why_now: Launch is in two days; the wider press has barely covered it and Gulf readers can show up at the launch event
angle.what_it_means_here: A Dubai-made UEFN island backed by DMCC Gaming Centre and tied to the Dubai Program for Gaming 2033; island code, platforms and price not announced, independent of Epic
angle.payoff: what is not yet known, and that Epic neither sponsors nor runs it

searched: DMCC press page (1920x1080 key art, the only image)
lowres_ok.result: only a 1920x1080 still exists; 9:16 crop is 1.78x, under the 2x cap

note: Stills with motion on the only official image: pans across the DMCC key art (30 Oct and 26 Oct rulings: official art with motion when there is no trailer). Sound: our bed, no footage with sound exists. Stand-in not used. Each line spans two pan shots so something changes every 4 s.
